queryRunnerSource: (sql,write=false)=>`async(page)=>{await page.getByRole('textbox',{name:'SQL query',exact:true}).fill(${JSON.stringify(sql)});let confirmation=null;if(${write}){await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Run query',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('alertdialog').waitFor();confirmation=await page.getByRole('alertdialog').ariaSnapshot();}const native=page.waitForResponse(r=>{if(!r.url().endsWith('/graphql'))return false;try{const a=r.request().postDataJSON();return(Array.isArray(a)?a:[a]).some(x=>x.operationName==='ExecuteDatabaseQuery'&&x.variables.sql===${JSON.stringify(sql)});}catch{return false;}},{timeout:25000});if(${write})await page.getByRole('alertdialog').getByRole('button',{name:'Run statement',exact:true}).click();else await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Run query',exact:true}).click();const r=await native;const request=r.request().postDataJSON();const body=await r.json();if(${write})await page.getByRole('alertdialog').waitFor({state:'detached'});await page.waitForTimeout(500);return {at:new Date().toISOString(),confirmation,request,status:r.status(),body,ui:await page.locator('#sql-console').ariaSnapshot()};}`
